description: Performs one action in the audit's browser and returns the updated page plus the tracking hits that action sent. Actions: goto (url), click (ref or text), fill (ref or text, value), select (ref or text, value), scroll (value = down or up), wait (value = milliseconds). Refs come from the latest page view, which lists on-screen elements first; if an element has no ref, scroll or pass its visible text in text. If a cookie banner appears, accept it and set accepts_consent to true on that click (or, on a journey that is about declining cookies, reject it and set rejects_consent to true). Use test data in forms and never enter real payment details.

accepts_consent.description: True only when this click accepts the cookie or consent banner.

reason.description: Short description of the step, e.g. 'Add the first product to the cart'. Shown in the report.

ref.description: Element ref for click, fill and select.

rejects_consent.description: True only when this click rejects or declines all cookies on the consent banner.

text.description: Instead of ref: the element's visible text or label, e.g. "Book now".

url.description: Destination for goto, absolute or relative to the current page.

value.description: Text to type, option to select, or milliseconds to wait.

name: browser_action
title: Act in the audit browser
